narrativeProgression.description: Azealia Banks starts recounting her experience on the flight.
She alleges the airline staff lied to the captain about her behavior.
She describes feeling treated like an animal by the staff.
She states she was cornered and treated poorly by "ugly Irish bitches."
She refuses to be disrespected by Aer Lingus.
She mentions finding a different flight.
She confirms her manager booked her another flight, showing slight relief.
She reiterates her anger and frustration towards the Aer Lingus staff.
She declares her intention to file a complaint.
She expresses disgust at the airline staff's behavior, comparing it to putting a monkey in a cage.
She speculates on the staff's racist motives.
She announces leaving the airport and calming down.
She seeks confirmation whether Ryan Air and Aer Lingus are the same company, showing anxiety about potentially rebooking with the same airline. She reassures her audience she will make it to Dublin.
